fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Compare/CompareTrucks.cy.js#Compare - CompareTrucks [hi] — Compare Trucks TC-CT-03: Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Compare Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CT-03
**Title:** Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Compare Trucks
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Open the Compare Trucks page, open the Check Offers lead form, fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown mobile-format and location-required validation messages are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Compare Trucks page
2. Open the Check Offers lead form
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city left empty
5. Verify the mobile-format and location validation messages are shown
